title: Motorway Night Run
short: Weave through night traffic, chain near misses, fire nitro and top the league.
full:
Motorway Night Run is a fast, arcade-style highway racer set on a glowing motorway at night.

Weave between cars, buses and trucks at full throttle. Pass vehicles closely for a NEAR MISS to fill your nitro, then unleash a burst of speed. Grab coins and fuel cans along the way, and don't run dry.

FEATURES
• Simple one-touch steering, with gas, brake and nitro buttons (auto-gas option)
• Near-miss combos that boost your score and charge nitro
• Missions that get harder as you complete them, with coin rewards
• Garage with 8 original cars to unlock, each with its own speed, handling and nitro
• Weekly League: your best run of the week is ranked against other players; the top 3 earn gold, silver and bronze badges that stay on your profile
• Works in portrait and landscape
• English and Urdu

FREE TO PLAY
The game is free and shows ads. You can watch an optional video to revive once or double your coins. Optional in-app purchases: Remove Ads (banner and full-screen ads), and coin packs.

اردو
موٹروے نائٹ رن رات کی موٹروے پر تیز رفتار ریسنگ گیم ہے۔ ٹریفک کے بیچ سے گاڑی نکالیں، قریب سے گزر کر نائٹرو بھریں، سکے اور فیول اٹھائیں، اور گیراج میں نئی گاڑیاں کھولیں۔ ہر ہفتے کی لیگ میں ٹاپ 3 کھلاڑیوں کو سونے، چاندی اور کانسی کے بیج ملتے ہیں۔ گیم مفت ہے، اس میں ایڈز ہیں، اور "ایڈز ہٹائیں" اور سکوں کے پیک کی اختیاری خریداری موجود ہے۔
